what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Switzerland, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 13 in 2021 to 316 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Switzerland list mass movements.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Switzerland in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 356 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Switzerland.
